definition.matched_control: same-population proxy-rejected/physical-hard candidate matched on regret; this is a control, not a claim that it participates in no inversion whatsoever
definition.score: proxy-rank margin times physical margin in metres
definition.strong_inversion: same-population pair where proxy prefers deceptive candidate, but corrective candidate is physically better by at least the physical gap

scope: post-hoc verification on persisted Phase-0 same-state candidate pools; not policy or query-efficiency evidence
